Do you believe in aliens? You will after this! GIVEAWAY time! Make your best halloween dessert using @Butterfinger! Post a picture on Instagram and use the hashtag #ButterfingerBakes for a chance to win an awesome prize! Giveaway ends October 31st at midnight! GOOD LUCK!


CHECK OUT OUR MERCH! → https://store.dftba.com/collections/daily-bumps

RECIPE: GIANT Butterfinger Cookie + Decorated BF Fun size bars
Ingredients:

• 1 cup butter, softened  
• 3/4 cup white sugar
• 3/4 cup packed brown sugar
• 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
• 2 eggs
• 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
• 1 teaspoon salt
• 1 teaspoon baking soda
• 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
• 1 cup chopped walnuts
• Butterfinger Fun Size
• Chocolate Frosting


Directions: 

1. In large bowl, beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.
2. Gradually add flour, salt, and baking soda, beating until well blended. Stir in chocolate chips, nuts and crush Butterfinger
3. Spread in greased 14 inch round pizza pan. Bake at 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) for 20-25 minutes. Cool cookie in pan on a cooling rack. 
4. Add chocolate frosting on top of the cookie followed by crush Butterfinger
5. Take BF fun size bars and decorate as your favorite halloween characters+ an alien one :)

Thanks to the Krispie Kitchen, I challenged Bryan and Ollie to Deck the Trees to see whose Rice Krispies Treats turned out the best! It was so much fun creating this sponsored video with Rice Krispies Treats – it’s a perfect way to spend some quality family time together…plus we got to eat all of the treats at the end! Check out Krispie Kitchen on Google Home, Google Assistant, or via the smart phone app, and begin your own decorating adventure by clicking here: https://bit.ly/2rGedGA! To get started say, “Hey Google, talk to Krispie Kitchen.” What would you put on your Rice Krispies Christmas Tree?

Try more Rice Krispies Treats holiday recipes:
- SANTA: https://bit.ly/2EqmjeO
- REINDEER: https://bit.ly/2SIy43h

One Pot Chicken Alfredo

1 Tbsp. olive oil
2 chicken breasts, cubed
3 garlic cloves, minced
14 oz chicken broth
1 cup heavy cream
1/2 lb uncooked penne pasta
1.5 cups grated parmesan
parsley for garnish (optional)

In a pot, heat the oil and brown the chicken. Add garlic, and sauté for about a minute. Add broth, cream, and pasta, and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat to a simmer for 15-20 min. Turn off heat and stir in parmesan cheese. Top with parsley if desired.

There's no secret code or anything telling you to comment or like today (feel free to do that on your own if you want)-- I just wanted to take this time to tell you that you guys have changed our lives and it's amazing. Watching Ollie grow into a little boy, and watching us learn as parents is something that I feel blessed to be able to go back and watch. No matter what happens, just know that your support is not taken in vain. I appreciate each and every one of you and if I ever have the opportunity to hug each and every one of you someday I will. Growing up and in high school I didn't have many friends, until Missy came along, so having so many friends all around the world who love and watch us blows my mind. I'm living proof that you don't have to be the hot popular kid in school to get somewhere. I'm living proof that you don't need dozens of friends to feel special. You're great in your way--just try and discover it and when you do, RUN with it. See what it becomes. Robin Williams said, "You're only given a little spark of madness. You mustn't lose it." Find your madness and hold onto it. It may lead you to a family of your own, or take you around the world, or even reveal a hidden talent you may have. The world is an amazing, beautiful, frightening place and it's yours to take. God bless and see ya tomorrow! - Bryan

N6yIFisTyLo.description:
Welcome to our channel! My wife and I daily vlog about our lives as a young couple who are expecting our first baby. We are so thrilled to meet Oliver this August! We've gone through many struggles on our journey to parenthood, but this time around are feeling very confident and positive that we'll be taking our little guy home!

Over the course of a year, we have lost two little boys. A 10 week miscarriage, and a 20 week stillbirth. It was devastating, but also something that instilled a great appreciation for children and becoming parents. We want to show the world that although we've gone through such hard times, we are very positive and happy people.

There is hope. We didn't think so when we were going through our struggles, but we've been shown that there is. Remember, you're never in it alone.

Click subscribe to follow our journey.

Check out my wife's pregnancy channel where she vlogs much more in depth about her experiences and pregnancy this time around. We put funny pregnancy and marriage videos up there as well. 
http://www.youtube.com/bumpsalongthewayvlog

You can follow me on Twitter
http://www.twitter.com/bryanlanning

and both of us on Instagram
http://www.instagram.com/bryanlanning
